notes.title: Skip Features is Available Now!!
notes.content:
Now, the next button will appear when you go into a level that you have completed. 

Meaning that you should be able to skip all the completed levels to where you have left, or go to a specific level that you want to replay.

notes.title: Achievements have fixed
notes.content: Achievements should all work now. Make sure update to the newest version of the game.
